text: Summary At its meeting on June 17, 2022, the TO Live – Human Resources, Compensation and Labour Relations Committee considered item RY14.2 and made recommendations to the Board of Directors of TO Live. Summary from the report (June 14, 2022) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live: This report is about labour relations or employee negotiations.

The Board of Directors of TO Live: 1. Adopted the confidential instructions to staff set out in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (June 14, 2022) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live. 2. Directed that the confidential information contained in the Confidential Attachment to the report (June 14, 2022) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live remain confidential in its entirety, as it is about labour relations and employee negotiations.
